entities.name: Thranegeld
entities.description: Dwarven docent and artificer at the Tolarian Academy of Lat-Nam, found dead in his chambers.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Academy of Lat-Nam where Thranegeld taught.

entities.name: Phyrexian agents
entities.description: Phyrexian infiltrators suspected in the academy.

entities.name: Ulf
entities.description: Struggling student whom Thranegeld assigned a project on Corondor.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Mysterious ancient realm lost to civilization.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: Demon King of Corondor, subject of a lost tome.

entities.name: Silas Brotten
entities.description: Disguised docent and Phyrexian agent who targeted Ulf and the tome.

events.summary: Thranegeld assigns Ulf a project on the history of Corondor and checks with a magical device that he is not a Phyrexian agent.
events.quote: assigned him a special project on the history of Corondor

events.summary: Ulf finds a lost tome on Sol'Kanar and Thranegeld advises him to keep it hidden.
events.quote: Thranegeld advised Ulf to keep it hidden and not to trust anyone else with its contents

events.summary: Thranegeld is found dead in his chambers, likely killed by Silas Brotten in Phyrexian form.
events.quote: Thranegeld met a grim fate, found dead in his chambers

relations.quote: Thranegeld was a dwarven docent at the Tolarian Academy of Lat-Nam
He played a pivotal role in the life of Ulf

relations.note: Likely killed him in his Phyrexian form.
relations.quote: likely Silas Brotten himself in his Phyrexian form
Phyrexian agents within the academy, including a disguised docent, Silas Brotten
